trial_court: learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Rahata bearing Criminal M.A. No.227/2020
case_name: Sandip Ishwardas Waghmare And Others vs Supriya Sandip Waghmare

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sandip Ishwardas Waghmare And Others (husband, wife, applicants)

facts_of_case: The applicant No.1 and the respondent No.1 had moved a joint petition for dissolution of their marriage under Section 13(b) of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: A joint petition for dissolution of marriage under Section 13(b) of the Hindu Marriage Act can be filed.
legal_principles.held: It appears that, the applicant No.1 and the respondent No.1 had moved a joint petition for dissolution of their marriage under Section 13(b) of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: Notice should be issued to the respondent in a joint petition for dissolution of marriage.
legal_principles.held: Issue notice to respondent returnable on 24th February 2022.

outcome.final_order: Pendency of this proceedings shall not be treated as stay to the proceedings pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Rahata bearing Criminal M.A. No.227/2020.
